why: The PE draw the tower 17% and the south wing 15% narrower than the cadastre measures them; the north wing and the gaps between are right. Each pair is one wall, drawing x then true x: the Calle 63 facade (P2's library), the tower's west face (P3-P5), its east face (P1-P5), the south wing's west face (P3-P5 above the auditorium) and the Calle 62 facade (P5-P8). Mapped so, P1's Calle 63 facade lands on the inner edge of the sidewalk that runs under the north wing.

groups.why: The PE draw the auditorium's front 4 m short of the south wing's, which the auditorium's own plan and P3-P5 above it reach; its back, on the lot next door, is right.

limits.why: The hall stops where the tower does: past it the cadastre records no roof, and P2 above stops there too.
The tower's seven-floor part ends at y 1911; beside its eight-floor part, below that, is the open patio over the parking.
The ramp runs out to the lot's edge on Carrera 9A, not onto the sidewalk.
The lobby ends where the part it is in does; past it is the patio.
